title: Fleetscope / Overview
description: Is the browser fleet healthy right now? Verdict first, then the numbers behind it. Every panel marked with an arrow opens the sessions behind its numbers.

panels.title: Fleet verdict ↗
panels.description: Success rate of the sessions that ended in the range, through the thresholds: 95% or more is healthy, 90 to 95% degraded, below 90% failed. Interrupted and still-running sessions are not counted; blocked counts against the rate. This panel's query also feeds the KPI row, Outcomes and Simulated share (their descriptions say which window each uses). The Sessions list holds every session that ran at any time in the range, so it contains these. Click to open the failed and blocked sessions.

targets.rawSql:
-- Fleet verdict AND the numbers of the whole KPI row, from one pass over session-facts. The panels Outcomes,
-- Simulated share, Active now, Sessions, Success rate, p95, CPU, Memory, Estimated cost and Interrupted read
-- their column from this result (Dashboard data source), so the per-session work runs once per refresh.
--   ended in the range:   ended, healthy, degraded, failed, blocked, interrupted, success_rate, verdict
--   started in the range: session_count, simulated_share, estimated_cost_usd
--   right now:            active_now, cpu_cores, memory_mib (a sample in the last 30 s; ignores the range)
--   per-minute rollup:    p95_ms (the actions of the range)
-- Success rate = (healthy + degraded) / ended; interrupted (Ctrl+C) sessions are left out, blocked counts against it.
-- Verdict: 95% or more healthy, 90% or more degraded, below that failed, no_data when no session ended.
WITH facts AS
(
    WITH
        picked AS
        (
            SELECT *
            FROM sessions FINAL
            WHERE engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
              AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
              AND started_at >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY
              AND started_at <= $__toTime
              AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= $__fromTime)
        ),
        issue_facts AS
        (
            SELECT session_id, count() AS issue_count, toString(argMin(kind, ts)) AS first_issue
            FROM issues
            WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM picked)
              AND ts >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM picked)
              AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
              AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
            GROUP BY session_id
        ),
        action_facts AS
        (
            SELECT
                session_id,
                count() AS actions,
                countIf(NOT ok) AS failed_actions,
                ifNull(argMinIf(error_code, seq, NOT ok), '') AS first_failed_code
            FROM actions
            WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM picked)
              AND ts >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM picked)
              AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
              AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
            GROUP BY session_id
        )
    SELECT
        p.session_id AS session_id,
        p.agent_id AS agent_id,
        p.source AS source,
        p.engine AS engine,
        p.routed_from AS routed_from,
        p.engine_version AS engine_version,
        p.provider AS provider,
        p.scenario AS scenario,
        p.started_at AS started_at,
        p.ended_at AS ended_at,
        p.status AS status,
        p.reason AS reason,
        p.duration_ms AS duration_ms,
        p.startup_ms + p.connect_ms AS time_to_browser_ms,
        (p.status = 'failed' AND ifNull(p.reason, '') = 'interrupted') AS is_interrupted,
        a.actions AS actions,
        a.failed_actions AS failed_actions,
        i.issue_count AS issue_count,
        multiIf(
            p.status = 'running', 'running',
            is_interrupted, 'interrupted',
            p.status = 'success' AND a.failed_actions = 0 AND i.issue_count = 0, 'healthy',
            p.status = 'success', 'degraded',
            p.status = 'blocked', 'blocked',
            'failed') AS display_status,
        if(p.status NOT IN ('running', 'success') AND NOT is_interrupted,
            multiIf(i.first_issue != '', i.first_issue, a.first_failed_code != '', a.first_failed_code, p.status),
            NULL) AS cause,
        if(cause IS NULL, NULL,
            multiIf(i.first_issue != '', 'issue', a.first_failed_code != '', 'action', 'status')) AS cause_from,
        (toUInt64(p.startup_ms) + p.connect_ms
            + ifNull(p.duration_ms, dateDiff('millisecond', p.started_at, now64(3)))) / 3.6e6 AS browser_hours,
        if(price.provider = '', NULL, browser_hours * price.usd_per_browser_hour) AS est_cost_usd
    FROM picked AS p
    LEFT JOIN issue_facts AS i ON i.session_id = p.session_id
    LEFT JOIN action_facts AS a ON a.session_id = p.session_id
    LEFT JOIN pricing_current AS price ON price.engine = p.engine AND price.provider = p.provider
),
    now_stats AS
    (
        SELECT
            count() AS active,
            sum(latest_cpu_pct) / 100 AS cores,
            sum(latest_mem_mib) AS mem
        FROM
        (
            SELECT
                session_id,
                argMax(toFloat64(assumeNotNull(cpu_pct)), ts) AS latest_cpu_pct,
                argMax(toFloat64(assumeNotNull(mem_mb)), ts) AS latest_mem_mib
            FROM resource_samples
            WHERE origin = 'container'
              AND cpu_pct IS NOT NULL
              AND mem_mb IS NOT NULL
              AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 SECOND
              AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
              AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
              AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM sessions FINAL WHERE status = 'running')
            GROUP BY session_id
        )
    ),
    rollup AS
    (
        SELECT if(countMerge(actions) = 0, NULL, quantilesMerge(0.5, 0.95)(action_ms)[2]) AS p95
        FROM fleet_minute
        WHERE minute >= toStartOfMinute($__fromTime) AND minute <= $__toTime
          AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
          AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
    )
SELECT
    countIf((ended_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)) AND NOT is_interrupted) AS ended,
    countIf((ended_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)) AND display_status = 'healthy') AS healthy,
    countIf((ended_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)) AND display_status = 'degraded') AS degraded,
    countIf((ended_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)) AND display_status = 'failed') AS failed,
    countIf((ended_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)) AND display_status = 'blocked') AS blocked,
    countIf((ended_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)) AND is_interrupted) AS interrupted,
    if(ended = 0, NULL, 100 * (healthy + degraded) / ended) AS success_rate,
    multiIf(success_rate IS NULL, 'no_data', success_rate >= 95, 'healthy', success_rate >= 90, 'degraded', 'failed') AS verdict,
    countIf($__timeFilter(started_at)) AS session_count,
    if(session_count = 0, NULL, 100 * countIf($__timeFilter(started_at) AND source = 'sim') / session_count) AS simulated_share,
    multiIf(session_count = 0, 0, countIf($__timeFilter(started_at) AND est_cost_usd IS NULL) > 0, NULL, sumIf(est_cost_usd, $__timeFilter(started_at))) AS estimated_cost_usd,
    (SELECT active FROM now_stats) AS active_now,
    (SELECT cores FROM now_stats) AS cpu_cores,
    (SELECT mem FROM now_stats) AS memory_mib,
    (SELECT p95 FROM rollup) AS p95_ms
FROM facts

panels.title: Outcomes ↗
panels.description: Sessions that ended in the range, by display status (from the Fleet verdict query). Degraded is a success with a failed action or an issue. Interrupted and running sessions are not outcomes. Click a bar to open those sessions.

panels.title: Simulated share ↗
panels.description: Simulated sessions as a share of the sessions that started in the range (from the Fleet verdict query; follows the engine and source filters). Simulated data comes from the simulator (source = sim). Click to open the simulated sessions.

panels.title: Active now ↗
panels.description: Running sessions with a container sample in the last 30 seconds (from the Fleet verdict query). Ignores the time range. Click to open the running sessions.

panels.title: Sessions ↗
panels.description: Sessions that started in the range, any status (from the Fleet verdict query). The Sessions list holds every session that ran at any time in the range, so it contains these. Click to open them.

panels.title: Success rate ↗
panels.description: Success divided by the sessions that ended in the range (from the Fleet verdict query). Interrupted and running sessions are left out; blocked counts against it. 95% or more is healthy, 90 to 95% degraded, below 90% failed. Click to open the failed and blocked sessions.

panels.title: p95 action latency ↗
panels.description: 95th percentile of the duration of the actions in the range, merged from the per-minute rollup (never an average of p95s; from the Fleet verdict query). Click to open the sessions.

panels.title: CPU in use ↗
panels.description: Sum of the latest CPU sample of every running session (Docker stats, 100% = one core; from the Fleet verdict query). Ignores the time range. Click to open the running sessions.

panels.title: Memory in use ↗
panels.description: Sum of the latest memory sample of every running session (Docker stats, MiB; from the Fleet verdict query). Ignores the time range. Click to open the running sessions.

panels.title: Estimated cost ↗
panels.description: Estimated cost of the sessions that started in the range (from the Fleet verdict query). Browser-hours × $0.10 per browser-hour (Browserbase's published price, from the `pricing` table). An estimate, not a bill. Not available when a session has no price. Click to open the sessions.

panels.title: Interrupted ↗
panels.description: Sessions that ended in the range on Ctrl+C of the runner (reason = interrupted; from the Fleet verdict query). They are not failures and are in no rate. Click to open them.

panels.title: Error rate by engine ↗
panels.description: Error rate = 100 minus the success rate, per bucket of the time the sessions ended: the sessions that ended in each bucket and did not succeed, interrupted ones left out. Shaded areas: 5% degraded, 10% failed. Click a line to open its sessions. The link carries the whole panel range, not the clicked minute: drag across a spike to zoom, then click.

        p.session_id AS session_id,
        p.agent_id AS agent_id,
        p.source AS source,
        p.engine AS engine,
        p.routed_from AS routed_from,
        p.engine_version AS engine_version,
        p.provider AS provider,
        p.scenario AS scenario,
        p.started_at AS started_at,
        p.ended_at AS ended_at,
        p.status AS status,
        p.reason AS reason,
        p.duration_ms AS duration_ms,

        (p.status = 'failed' AND ifNull(p.reason, '') = 'interrupted') AS is_interrupted,
        a.actions AS actions,
        a.failed_actions AS failed_actions,
        i.issue_count AS issue_count,
        multiIf(
            p.status = 'running', 'running',
            is_interrupted, 'interrupted',

            p.status = 'success', 'degraded',

            'failed') AS display_status,

            multiIf(i.first_issue != '', i.first_issue, a.first_failed_code != '', a.first_failed_code, p.status),
            NULL) AS cause,

SELECT
    $__timeInterval(ended_at) AS time,
    engine,
    if(countIf(NOT is_interrupted) = 0, NULL,
        100 * countIf(NOT is_interrupted AND status != 'success') / countIf(NOT is_interrupted)) AS error_rate
FROM facts
WHERE (ended_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at))
GROUP BY time, engine

panels.title: Active sessions by engine ↗
panels.description: Sessions running in each bucket: started before its end and not ended before its start, counted from the sessions table at query time. Click a line to open its sessions. The link carries the whole panel range, not the clicked minute: drag across a spike to zoom, then click.

targets.rawSql:
-- Sessions running in each bucket, per engine: a session counts in every minute from its start to its end
-- (until now if it has not ended). Comes from the sessions table at query time, not from the rollup.
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(minute) AS time,
    engine,
    uniq(session_id) AS active_sessions
FROM
(
    SELECT
        session_id,
        engine,
        arrayJoin(range(
            greatest(toUInt32(toStartOfMinute(started_at)), toUInt32(toStartOfMinute($__fromTime))),
            least(toUInt32(toStartOfMinute(coalesce(ended_at, now64(3)))), toUInt32($__toTime)) + 1,
            60)) AS minute_epoch,
        toDateTime(minute_epoch, 'UTC') AS minute
    FROM sessions FINAL
    WHERE engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
      AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
      AND started_at <= $__toTime
      AND coalesce(ended_at, now64(3)) >= $__fromTime
)
GROUP BY time, engine
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Actions per minute by engine ↗
panels.description: Browser actions per minute from the per-minute rollup (fleet_minute), divided by the bucket length. Click a line to open its sessions. The link carries the whole panel range, not the clicked minute: drag across a spike to zoom, then click.

targets.rawSql:
-- Actions per minute, per engine, from the per-minute rollup (buckets wider than a minute are divided down).
-- The minute that contains the start of the range is included, so its actions after "from" are not lost.
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(minute) AS time,
    engine,
    countMerge(actions) / (greatest($__interval_s, 60) / 60) AS actions_per_min
FROM fleet_minute
WHERE minute >= toStartOfMinute($__fromTime) AND minute <= $__toTime
  AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
  AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, engine
ORDER BY time

panels.title: By engine ↗
panels.description: One row per engine. Sessions and Est. cost: sessions that started in the range. Status, Success rate and Top cause: sessions that ended in the range (interrupted left out). Success rate leaves running sessions out. CPU is the average of container samples (% of one core), Memory the average of each session's peak, Active now counts samples of the last 30 seconds. Cost: Browser-hours × $0.10 per browser-hour (Browserbase's published price, from the `pricing` table). An estimate, not a bill. Click an engine to open its sessions. The Sessions list holds every session that ran at any time in the range, so it contains these.

targets.rawSql:
-- One row per engine; session-facts is read ONCE. No totals row: the KPI row is the total.
--   Sessions, Est. cost:                       sessions that STARTED in the range
--   Status, Success rate, Top cause:           sessions that ENDED in the range (interrupted ones left out)
--   p95 and CPU: per-minute rollup. Memory: average of each started session's peak. Active now: a sample in the last 30 s.
-- Memory is NULL (Not available) for an engine with no container sample: an unmatched LEFT JOIN row would read 0 (join_use_nulls = 0), so it goes through peak_n.
-- Top cause = the most common cause among the engine's unsuccessful sessions; a tie goes to the first name alphabetically.
WITH facts AS
(
    WITH
        picked AS
        (
            SELECT *
            FROM sessions FINAL
            WHERE engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
              AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
              AND started_at >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY
              AND started_at <= $__toTime
              AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= $__fromTime)
        ),
        issue_facts AS
        (
            SELECT session_id, count() AS issue_count, toString(argMin(kind, ts)) AS first_issue
            FROM issues
            WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM picked)
              AND ts >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM picked)
              AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
              AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
            GROUP BY session_id
        ),
        action_facts AS
        (
            SELECT
                session_id,
                count() AS actions,
                countIf(NOT ok) AS failed_actions,
                ifNull(argMinIf(error_code, seq, NOT ok), '') AS first_failed_code
            FROM actions
            WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM picked)
              AND ts >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM picked)
              AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
              AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
            GROUP BY session_id
        )
    SELECT
        p.session_id AS session_id,
        p.agent_id AS agent_id,
        p.source AS source,
        p.engine AS engine,
        p.routed_from AS routed_from,
        p.engine_version AS engine_version,
        p.provider AS provider,
        p.scenario AS scenario,
        p.started_at AS started_at,
        p.ended_at AS ended_at,
        p.status AS status,
        p.reason AS reason,
        p.duration_ms AS duration_ms,
        p.startup_ms + p.connect_ms AS time_to_browser_ms,
        (p.status = 'failed' AND ifNull(p.reason, '') = 'interrupted') AS is_interrupted,
        a.actions AS actions,
        a.failed_actions AS failed_actions,
        i.issue_count AS issue_count,
        multiIf(
            p.status = 'running', 'running',
            is_interrupted, 'interrupted',
            p.status = 'success' AND a.failed_actions = 0 AND i.issue_count = 0, 'healthy',
            p.status = 'success', 'degraded',
            p.status = 'blocked', 'blocked',
            'failed') AS display_status,
        if(p.status NOT IN ('running', 'success') AND NOT is_interrupted,
            multiIf(i.first_issue != '', i.first_issue, a.first_failed_code != '', a.first_failed_code, p.status),
            NULL) AS cause,
        if(cause IS NULL, NULL,
            multiIf(i.first_issue != '', 'issue', a.first_failed_code != '', 'action', 'status')) AS cause_from,
        (toUInt64(p.startup_ms) + p.connect_ms
            + ifNull(p.duration_ms, dateDiff('millisecond', p.started_at, now64(3)))) / 3.6e6 AS browser_hours,
        if(price.provider = '', NULL, browser_hours * price.usd_per_browser_hour) AS est_cost_usd
    FROM picked AS p
    LEFT JOIN issue_facts AS i ON i.session_id = p.session_id
    LEFT JOIN action_facts AS a ON a.session_id = p.session_id
    LEFT JOIN pricing_current AS price ON price.engine = p.engine AND price.provider = p.provider
),
    per_engine AS
    (
        SELECT
            engine,
            argMax(engine_version, started_at) AS version,
            countIf($__timeFilter(started_at)) AS sessions,
            countIf((ended_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)) AND NOT is_interrupted) AS ended,
            countIf((ended_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)) AND display_status IN ('healthy', 'degraded')) AS succeeded,
            if(ended = 0, NULL, 100 * succeeded / ended) AS success_rate,
            multiIf(sessions = 0, 0, countIf($__timeFilter(started_at) AND est_cost_usd IS NULL) > 0, NULL, sumIf(est_cost_usd, $__timeFilter(started_at))) AS estimated_cost_usd,
            groupArrayIf(assumeNotNull(cause), (ended_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)) AND cause IS NOT NULL) AS causes,
            arraySort(x -> (-countEqual(causes, x), x), arrayDistinct(causes))[1] AS top_cause,
            countEqual(causes, top_cause) AS top_n
        FROM facts
        GROUP BY engine
    ),
    running AS
    (
        SELECT engine, uniq(session_id) AS active_now
        FROM resource_samples
        WHERE origin = 'container'
          AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 SECOND
          AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
          AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
          AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM sessions FINAL WHERE status = 'running')
        GROUP BY engine
    ),
    rollup AS
    (
        SELECT
            engine,
            countMerge(actions) AS action_count,
            quantilesMerge(0.5, 0.95)(action_ms)[2] AS p95_ms,
            if(countMerge(samples) = 0, NULL, sumMerge(cpu_pct_sum) / countMerge(samples)) AS cpu_pct
        FROM fleet_minute
        WHERE minute >= toStartOfMinute($__fromTime) AND minute <= $__toTime
          AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
          AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
        GROUP BY engine
    ),
    peaks AS
    (
        SELECT engine, avgOrNull(peak_mib) AS avg_peak_mib, countIf(peak_mib IS NOT NULL) AS peak_n
        FROM
        (
            SELECT engine, session_id, maxOrNull(mem_mb) AS peak_mib
            FROM resource_samples
            WHERE origin = 'container'
              AND ts >= $__fromTime
              AND session_id IN (
                  SELECT session_id FROM sessions FINAL
                  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote}) AND source IN (${source:singlequote}))
            GROUP BY engine, session_id
        )
        GROUP BY engine
    )
SELECT
    e.engine AS engine,
    multiIf(e.success_rate IS NULL, NULL, e.success_rate >= 95, 'healthy', e.success_rate >= 90, 'degraded', 'failed') AS status,
    e.sessions AS sessions,
    e.success_rate AS success_rate,
    if(e.top_n = 0, NULL, concat(e.top_cause, ' ×', toString(e.top_n))) AS top_cause,
    if(ro.action_count = 0, NULL, ro.p95_ms) AS p95_ms,
    ro.cpu_pct AS cpu_pct,
    if(p.peak_n = 0, NULL, p.avg_peak_mib) AS avg_peak_mib,
    e.estimated_cost_usd AS estimated_cost_usd,
    r.active_now AS active_now,
    e.version AS version
FROM per_engine AS e
LEFT JOIN running AS r ON r.engine = e.engine
LEFT JOIN rollup AS ro ON ro.engine = e.engine
LEFT JOIN peaks AS p ON p.engine = e.engine
ORDER BY e.engine

panels.title: Recent failures ↗
panels.description: The 15 newest sessions that ended in the range without success (failed, timeout, crashed or blocked); interrupted sessions are left out. Session shows the first 8 characters of the id. Cause is the code and the reason of the session. Click a status or a session to open it.

            'failed') AS display_status,
        if(p.status NOT IN ('running', 'success') AND NOT is_interrupted,
            multiIf(i.first_issue != '', i.first_issue, a.first_failed_code != '', a.first_failed_code, p.status),
            NULL) AS cause,
        if(cause IS NULL, NULL,
            multiIf(i.first_issue != '', 'issue', a.first_failed_code != '', 'action', 'status')) AS cause_from,
        (toUInt64(p.startup_ms) + p.connect_ms
            + ifNull(p.duration_ms, dateDiff('millisecond', p.started_at, now64(3)))) / 3.6e6 AS browser_hours,
        if(price.provider = '', NULL, browser_hours * price.usd_per_browser_hour) AS est_cost_usd
    FROM picked AS p
    LEFT JOIN issue_facts AS i ON i.session_id = p.session_id
    LEFT JOIN action_facts AS a ON a.session_id = p.session_id
    LEFT JOIN pricing_current AS price ON price.engine = p.engine AND price.provider = p.provider
)
SELECT
    ended_at AS time,
    display_status AS status,
    if(match(session_id, '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-'), substring(session_id, 1, 8), session_id) AS session,
    engine,
    scenario,
    if(ifNull(reason, '') = '', cause, concat(cause, ': ', reason)) AS cause_text,
    source,
    session_id,
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli(started_at) - 5000 AS from_ms,
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ended_at) + 5000 AS to_ms
FROM facts
WHERE (ended_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)) AND cause IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ended_at DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top failure causes ↗
panels.description: The 10 most common causes among the sessions that ended in the range without success (interrupted left out). Cause is the kind of the first issue (from issue), else the error_code of the first failed action (from action), else the status (from status). Click a cause for two links: its latest session, or all failed and blocked sessions that ran in the range with that cause.

targets.rawSql:
-- Why sessions fail: the cause of each session that ENDED in the range without success (interrupted left out).
-- Cause = kind of the first issue (from issue), else error_code of the first failed action (action), else the status (status).
-- session_id, from_ms and to_ms (hidden) belong to the latest session with that cause, for the "Latest session" link.
WITH facts AS
(
    WITH
        picked AS
        (
            SELECT *
            FROM sessions FINAL
            WHERE engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
              AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
              AND started_at >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY
              AND started_at <= $__toTime
              AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= $__fromTime)
        ),
        issue_facts AS
        (
            SELECT session_id, count() AS issue_count, toString(argMin(kind, ts)) AS first_issue
            FROM issues
            WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM picked)
              AND ts >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM picked)
              AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
              AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
            GROUP BY session_id
        ),
        action_facts AS
        (
            SELECT
                session_id,
                count() AS actions,
                countIf(NOT ok) AS failed_actions,
                ifNull(argMinIf(error_code, seq, NOT ok), '') AS first_failed_code
            FROM actions
            WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM picked)
              AND ts >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM picked)
              AND engine IN (${engine:singlequote})
              AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
            GROUP BY session_id
        )
    SELECT
        p.session_id AS session_id,
        p.agent_id AS agent_id,
        p.source AS source,
        p.engine AS engine,
        p.routed_from AS routed_from,
        p.engine_version AS engine_version,
        p.provider AS provider,
        p.scenario AS scenario,
        p.started_at AS started_at,
        p.ended_at AS ended_at,
        p.status AS status,
        p.reason AS reason,
        p.duration_ms AS duration_ms,
        p.startup_ms + p.connect_ms AS time_to_browser_ms,
        (p.status = 'failed' AND ifNull(p.reason, '') = 'interrupted') AS is_interrupted,
        a.actions AS actions,
        a.failed_actions AS failed_actions,
        i.issue_count AS issue_count,
        multiIf(
            p.status = 'running', 'running',
            is_interrupted, 'interrupted',
            p.status = 'success' AND a.failed_actions = 0 AND i.issue_count = 0, 'healthy',
            p.status = 'success', 'degraded',
            p.status = 'blocked', 'blocked',
            'failed') AS display_status,
        if(p.status NOT IN ('running', 'success') AND NOT is_interrupted,
            multiIf(i.first_issue != '', i.first_issue, a.first_failed_code != '', a.first_failed_code, p.status),
            NULL) AS cause,
        if(cause IS NULL, NULL,
            multiIf(i.first_issue != '', 'issue', a.first_failed_code != '', 'action', 'status')) AS cause_from,
        (toUInt64(p.startup_ms) + p.connect_ms
            + ifNull(p.duration_ms, dateDiff('millisecond', p.started_at, now64(3)))) / 3.6e6 AS browser_hours,
        if(price.provider = '', NULL, browser_hours * price.usd_per_browser_hour) AS est_cost_usd
    FROM picked AS p
    LEFT JOIN issue_facts AS i ON i.session_id = p.session_id
    LEFT JOIN action_facts AS a ON a.session_id = p.session_id
    LEFT JOIN pricing_current AS price ON price.engine = p.engine AND price.provider = p.provider
)
SELECT
    cause,
    cause_from,
    sum(n) AS sessions,
    arrayStringConcat(
        arrayMap(x -> concat(x.1, ' ', toString(x.2)), arrayReverseSort(x -> x.2, groupArray((engine, n)))),
        ', ') AS engines,
    argMax(latest_session, latest_ended) AS session_id,
    argMax(latest_from_ms, latest_ended) AS from_ms,
    argMax(latest_to_ms, latest_ended) AS to_ms
FROM
(
    SELECT
        cause,
        cause_from,
        engine,
        count() AS n,
        max(ended_at) AS latest_ended,
        argMax(session_id, ended_at) AS latest_session,
        argMax(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(started_at) - 5000, ended_at) AS latest_from_ms,
        argMax(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ended_at) + 5000, ended_at) AS latest_to_ms
    FROM facts
    WHERE (ended_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ended_at)) AND cause IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cause, cause_from, engine
)
GROUP BY cause, cause_from
ORDER BY sessions DESC, cause
LIMIT 10
